source.frame: ENU m: x=Dagor X, y=Dagor Z, z=Dagor Y (up), minus origin_dagor_xz; t = replay packet time, s

fields.kills: replay kill feed (KillMessage: killer, victim, weapon, death/weapon type)
fields.countermeasures: replay projectiles (time, owner); flare/chaff from spin/lifetime (candidate)
fields.target: seeker block (candidate layout) > kill feed > shooter designation (6,0) (candidate) > geometry; see launch target_basis.source
fields.aircraft_velocity: decoded sync velocity at 36949 samples (candidate scale), else finite differences
fields.outcome: kill feed / damage messages / DVM messages + closest approach; see missile_end outcome_basis
fields.launch_time: creation_raw_fields.creation_time > created_at_ms > first track sample (evidence grade C); see launch launch_t_source, t_first_sample; launch_pos_enu = creation_raw_fields.starting_pos

unknown: radar / RWR display state (sensor and designation fields exported only as candidates)
source.anonymised: player names replaced by team codes (A = team 0, B = team 1); local paths and source hashes removed
